summary: Venu Holding Corp filed an 8-K to disclose entry into an at-the-market (ATM) sales agreement with ThinkEquity LLC, allowing the sale of up to $250 million of common stock at prevailing market prices. The company pays a 3% commission; no minimum sale obligation exists. This routine equity shelf facility is not a special situation—it is ordinary capital markets activity. No recommendation, no forced change, no structural event.
